# The neighbour's offer has an end date

Our backup driver can help until her new job starts. Put the date beside the name, not in a separate message I will forget. [[Care arrangements]] should make a temporary offer easy to use and easy to finish. A person ought not have to withdraw kindness as if breaking a promise.
